title: daily-scratchpad-gpu-ops-32
content:
Mar 2-3 2026 - daily scratchpad (GPU ops)

Top of mind:
- Prep for capacity spike Friday (customer A pilot). need to reserve +20 A100-80GB or enable burst pool. check Dedicated quota.
- Follow up on network MTU issue seen on 2026-02-28 during large scatter-gather job.
- Rolling kernel update on gpu-nodes-az1 next Tue — coordinate SRE, notify oncall.

TODO (short):
- [ ] Reserve burst capacity for customer A (owner: Avery) — target +20 A100-80GB by Fri 2026-03-05
- [ ] Validate autoscaler policy for low-latency jobs (ticket JIRA-OPS-1423)
- [ ] Run quick perf check on model-x on quantized profile q8_0 — compare p50/p95 to baseline
- [ ] Add MTU change to runbook and test in staging (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm KMS rotation window won't affect private deployments (Diego)

Quick notes / commands:
- Check GPU inventory: kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide; then ssh to node and run nvidia-smi -L / nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv
- Autoscaler logs: kubectl -n infra logs deploy/gpu-autoscaler --since=2h | grep "scale"
- Recent capacity snapshot (approx): total GPUs=120; A100-80GB=36, A100-40GB=42, T4=42. Allocated to hosted/dedicated/private: hosted=60, dedicated=48, private=12 (rough). Need +20 for pilot.
- If quota short, fallback: schedule customer A to run on mixed A100-40GB with higher batch sizes + config to reduce latency impact.

Network MTU issue summary:
- Saw packet fragmentation / retransmit spikes at 9:12am 2026-02-28 across az1 -> az2 during large all-reduce.
- Hypothesis: MTU mismatch between new CNI version and old host config.
- Immediate mitigation: bump pod MTU to 1450 on affected node-pools, re-run tests.
- Longer: standardize MTU in bootstrap + add integ test that runs all-reduce with large tensors.

Rolling kernel update plan (gpu-nodes-az1):
- Maintenance window Tue 03/09 02:00-05:00 UTC (confirm with SRE)
- Steps: cordon -> drain -> kernel install -> reboot -> smoke test (gpu perf smoke) -> uncordon
- Can stagger per rack to keep capacity. Notify sales & CS about potential short slowdown.

Perf testing notes:
- Model-x quantization test steps:
  1) Deploy model-x:q8_0 to staging cluster (route small percentage)
  2) Run synthetic trace mixture (latency-sensitive prompt set) ~ 5000 requests
  3) Collect p50/p95 and compare to baseline (non-quant).
  4) If p95 degrade <= 8% and token quality delta < threshold => enable profile + add to Optimize suggestions
- Use bench script: infra/tools/bench/gpu_bench.py --model model-x --profile q8_0 --requests 5000 --concurrency 20

Follow-ups / remind me:
- Ping Priya to run staging MTU test + share logs (who: Priya)
- Sync with Diego about KMS rotation windows (add to weekly infra sync)
- Update runbook: "gpu-node-rolling-updates.md" with reboot steps + smoke tests

Notes to self (quick):
- Keep CLI snippets in /home/avery/notes/gpu-ops.md for faster copy-paste during incidents.
- If we can free up 10 A100-80GB from non-critical workloads, we can avoid burst quota. Check low-priority pool.
- Consider pre-warming NVLink rings for big all-reduce jobs (ask research team for recommended settings).

End of scratchpad
